name: Related Skills
headline: music-downloader: Claude Code skill for Audio
short_description: This skill enables downloading high-quality audio from various platforms using yt-dlp and spotdl. It's designed for users who want to extract audio from a variety of media sources, including YouTube and Spotify.
author: nymbo

sections.overview:
The music-downloader skill enables downloading high-quality audio from multiple platforms including YouTube and Spotify. It leverages yt-dlp and spotdl technologies to extract audio from various media sources. This skill is designed for users who need to save audio content locally from diverse streaming and video platforms.
Download individual songs from YouTube or Spotify.
Extract audio from entire playlists or albums.
Perform batch downloads while preserving metadata and album art.
sections.setup:
Terminal
Copy
`$ npx skills add https://github.com/nymbo/skills --skill music-downloader`
`git clone https://github.com/nymbo/skills`
sections.usage:
```
Download the highest quality audio available from [PLATFORM: YouTube, Spotify, SoundCloud, etc.] for the song '[SONG_NAME]' by [ARTIST_NAME]. Save it as '[FILE_NAME]' in the folder '[FOLDER_PATH]' using yt-dlp or spotdl. Ensure the audio is in MP3 format with a bitrate of at least 320kbps.
```
